purpose: Confirm that something happened and say what comes next.
layout: Centred success mark or illustration, a one-line headline, a short explanation, then a compact summary card of what was done. One primary next step and one quiet secondary link.

primaryAction.note: One filled next-step button at the bottom; the secondary is a text link.

hero.what: the outcome — the amount, the score, or the confirmation icon
hero.size: a display figure or icon of 72–96px centred in the top third, with one line of copy under it

avoid: Tab bar on a result screen of a flow

variants.layout: Centred: big success mark, headline, summary card, next-step button.
Receipt: headline at the top, then a receipt-like card with a dashed divider and line items, next-step button.
Illustration: a large illustration filling the top half, headline and one line, then two summary facts side by side.

kit:
[outcome]

[what happens next]

[fact][value]
